description: I’ve been looking at the campaign contributions reported by my Republican competitor and my own campaign. The difference is striking. His funding largely represents private industry interests, including Chevron, oil and gas companies, data centers and other large businesses. Mine comes from individuals, workers, educators and local Democratic organizations. My campaign has nearly three times as many individual and community contributors.
